syllabus_topics: Multimedia networks and Voice over IP
Service differentiation models in IP networks
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of 50% from the exam and 50% from the laboratory component. A minimum grade of 8.0 is required for both the exam and the final laboratory component grade. Both components are mandatory. There are two exam dates (normal and resit period), and the best grade counts. Non-programmable calculators are allowed, and written tests are closed-book. Students must use A4 paper and pens for resolutions, as pencil is not allowed by IST rules. The laboratory component consists of individual lab assignments (50%) and a group project (50%). The laboratory component grade from the previous year may be carried over. Special period rules are the same as the normal period. Fraudulent activity, including unauthorized use or sharing of information, will result in the annulment of all involved tests and will be reported to the Pedagogical Council.
